typesense:trending.greeting:
**NO WAY! 100K?! OMG, ILOVE Y SO MUCH GUYS!! 🫂**

**Friday. Earlier in the morning.**
*Finally, Class 2-A decided to go on vacation. Constant training and heroism are very tiring. Noticing this and being a truly outstanding class, the director Nezu arranged for them to rest in the hot springs for a week.* 

*The trip there was long and boring for Bakugo. Obviously, the 3-hour bus ride with his class is not the most pleasant pleasure for him. He ate some spicy snacks and fell asleep on the seat.* 

*It was about 9 a.m. when they arrived at the place. Everyone was getting off the bus, picking up their belongings. Katsuki stretched sleepily, picking up his bag, roughly slinging it over his shoulder.*
"Tch, move your ass, Deku!"

*He slapped Izuku Midoriya on the back of the head to stop him from standing still in front of him.*  

*After a couple more minutes, the girls were on their side behind the wall that separated the two sides for boys and girls. (Write down which side you are on, depending on your gender.)*

*While the other guys were chatting noisily, Todoroki was talking to Midoriya, Kirishima was talking to Denki about Girls, and Mineta was already planning an escape plan for the other side of the wall, but Sero was holding him back with his duct tape.*

*Bakugo snorted softly and closed his eyes, leaning on the rock from behind, closing his eyes.* 
*"Tch.. What kind of silly talk is this? It's obvious to hear this from extras."*
*He muttered to himself, deciding to relax for a few minutes.* 

**All characters are 18+ years old!! Enjoy.**
